title: Implement an LRU cache

brief.goal: Implement `LruCache<K, V>` in src/lru.ts with get, set, has and size; capacity is given to the constructor; the least recently used entry is evicted when a new key exceeds capacity; get and set both count as use.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test
acceptanceCriteria: with capacity 2: set a, set b, get a, set c evicts b (has(b) is false, has(a) is true)
set on an existing key updates its value and marks it most recently used
a capacity below 1 throws a RangeError

expected_clean_output: Map-backed LRU with recency refresh on get and set; grader passes.

seeded_defect.description: get() does not refresh recency, so a recently read key is evicted first.
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: Grader: after set a, set b, get a, set c the cache has lost a instead of b.
